channel.description: Recent content in Features on War Report

item.title: Players
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
The player page shows a player’s details, such as hero and troop levels. Use the buttons in the top-right corner to open the pages below.

  • Battle shows the player’s battle log, ranking, and league history, covering normal, ranked, and Legend League attacks.
  • Attacks lists every Clan War and CWL attack and defense the player has made, with a filter for friendly wars.
  • Stats aggregates Clan War and CWL performance over a selected time period.
  • Previous Clans lists the clans the player has belonged to and the total time spent in each.
  • Esports shows the player’s tournament statistics from the Competitive Clash Network.
  • Achievements tracks the player’s progress across every in-game achievement, grouped by category (Home Village, Builder Base, Clan Capital).
  • Armies shows every army composition from the player’s recent battle log, grouped by dominant troop, with average stars, destruction, and attack count. Tap Open in-game to copy one into the game.

Search players

To search for a player, tap the button in the bottom-right corner of the players page. You can search by tag or by name. Name search is based on data from the ClashKing Discord bot and may not include every player.

The image below shows where to find a player tag. Tap your experience level (1) to open your profile (2), then copy the tag (3) below your name.

Bookmark players

Bookmark your favorite players by tapping the bookmark button in the top-right corner of their page. To remove a bookmark, tap the button again or swipe the player left or right in your bookmarks list. You can also reorder bookmarks: tap and hold an entry, then drag it into place.

item.title: Clans
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
The clan page shows a clan’s details, such as its member list and its record of wins, losses, and ties in Clan Wars. Use the buttons in the top-right corner to open the pages below.

  • War log shows the clan’s Clan War and CWL results.
  • Stats aggregates Clan War and CWL performance over a selected time period, for the clan and each of its members.
  • Esports shows the clan’s tournament statistics from the Competitive Clash Network, including its players and matches.
  • Raid Weekend tracks the clan’s Clan Capital performance, with detailed statistics for each Raid Weekend.

Search clans

To search for a clan, tap the button in the bottom-right corner of the clans page. You can search by tag or by name.

The image below shows where to find a clan tag. Tap your experience level (1) to open your profile, tap your clan (2), then copy the tag (3) below the clan name.

Bookmark clans

Bookmark your favorite clans by tapping the bookmark button in the top-right corner of their page. To remove a bookmark, tap the button again or swipe the clan left or right in your bookmarks list. You can also reorder bookmarks: tap and hold an entry, then drag it into place.

item.title: Clan Wars
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
The Wars tab shows the ongoing clan wars of your bookmarked players and clans. As soon as a player or clan enters a war, a button at the bottom of their page also links to the war.

  • Live overview of every ongoing war across your bookmarked players and clans.
  • World Championship shows the qualifier standings for selected events and divisions.
  • Filters in the top-right corner let you choose which war types to show and exclude clans or players from the list.
  • Past wars open when you tap an entry in a war log. This data comes from the ClashKing Discord bot, so some wars may not have been tracked.

If you have many bookmarks, the list can take longer to load, so use the filter to narrow it down to the wars you’re interested in.


Regular and friendly clan wars require your clan to have a public war log. If it is private, ask your leader to change the clan settings. The Clan War League does not require a public war log.

item.title: Clan War League
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
If a clan war belongs to the Clan War League, you will find a button at the bottom of the clan war page that will take you to the clan war league page. For additional information about a clan or player, click on an item in the group or player list.

  • Group standings for the clans in the group with stars and destruction.
  • Round results for each of the seven war days.
  • Player rankings for the entire group, sortable by stars, destruction, or attacks used.
  • Clan and player stats when you tap on an individual clan or player.
  • Substitutions shows which players were selected for each Clan War League round and how the roster changed between rounds.
  • Earned medals (both base medals and bonus medals) per clan and per player. See How are Clan War League medals calculated? for the math behind these numbers.
  • Past seasons open when you tap an entry in the war log. This data comes from the ClashKing Discord bot, so some Clan War League months may not have been tracked. See Why can’t I view a completed CWL season right away? in the FAQ for more information.

item.title: Clan Capital
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Open the clan page and tap the menu button in the top-right corner to reach this page. It tracks your clan’s Clan Capital performance, with detailed statistics for each Raid Weekend.

For the math behind raid medal payouts, see How are Raid Weekend rewards calculated?.

  • Summary with the weekend’s total raid medals earned, attacks used, districts destroyed, and Capital Gold looted, plus each member’s attacks and stats.
  • Attacks breaks down every clan you raided, with the districts destroyed, medals earned, and how attacks were distributed across your members.
  • Defenses shows how attacking clans performed against your Clan Capital, including the districts they destroyed and the medals you earned in defense.

item.title: Battle
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Open the player page and tap the battle log button in the top-right corner to reach this page. It shows the player’s recent battle log, ranking, and league history, covering normal, ranked, and Legend League battles.

  • Log lists every recent attack and defense with the army that was used. A filter narrows entries by army type (Air or Ground) or by specific troops, spells, siege machines, or hero equipment.
  • Ranking shows the player’s current standing within their group. In Legend League I, it is replaced by a Legend League tab showing trophy progression for the current season.
  • History shows the player’s league progression over time, including past ranked league finishes and Legend League seasons.

item.title: Legend League
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Open the player page and tap the button in the top-right corner to reach this page. It shows the player’s Legend League performance for the current season.

  • Daily trophy gains and losses for the current season.
  • Progression graph visualizing how the player’s trophies change throughout the month.


The history may not include every attack and defense. War Report tries to track every player in Legend League I to show their full season of trophy gains and losses, but it can still be incomplete — for example, if the player makes many unranked attacks. For players in Legend League II or III, only the attacks and defenses from the recent battle log are shown.

item.title: Popular Armies
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Open the Popular Armies page from the More menu. It shows the most-used army compositions of the top 200 Legend League players.

For more information, see How often are the popular armies updated, and where does the data come from?.

  • Army cards showing the dominant troop, total usage count, average stars, and average destruction.
  • Army details when you tap a card, showing the Legend League players who used that army, sorted by average stars and destruction.
  • Open in-game to copy an army’s exact composition into the game with a single tap.

item.title: Army Stats
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Open Army Stats from the More menu to see how armies are used in the Legend League. Unlike Popular Armies, which is based on the current top 200 players, Army Stats counts attacks of all players in Legend League I.

Daily

  • Day summary with the total attacks, players, and armies, average stars, 3-star rate, average destruction, and the star distribution.
  • Army ranking ordered by usage, with each army’s usage share, average stars, and average destruction.

Tap an army to see its full composition, and its performance broken down by hero, equipment loadout, and pet. You can also open the army in-game.

Trends

The Trends tab compares the leading armies across the last 14 available days. Use the selector to compare usage, 3-star rate, average stars, or average destruction over time.

item.title: Account
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
Creating an account in the app settings unlocks extra features. You can sign in with an email and password, your Discord account, or your Apple ID.

  • Cross-device sync keeps your bookmarked players, clans, and settings in sync across every device you’re signed in on, so you can switch between phone and tablet without losing track of your favorites.
  • Push notifications keep you up to date on important clan activity, such as a reminder when you still have a war attack to use. Customize them anytime in the app settings.

Deleting your account

You can delete your account at any time from the app’s More menu, or at warreport.app/more. Deleting your account removes your synced data from the backend; see the Privacy Policy for details on retention.

item.title: API
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
There’s a public API at https://api.warreport.app that serves additional Legend League and army statistics. The full contract is published as an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.

The Legend League rankings are an end-of-season snapshot; the army, hero, and equipment stats are refreshed daily:

  • Legend League rankings: global player and clan rankings, plus per-country breakdowns. Captured once at the end of each Legend season.
  • Popular armies: the most-used army compositions among the top 200 Legend League players, with average stars and destruction. Updated daily.
  • Heroes and hero equipment: usage statistics for heroes and hero equipment among top Legend League players. Updated daily.

No API key is required. The data is free to use for anything. If the data shows up somewhere public, please credit War Report by mentioning the app and linking to https://warreport.app.

If you build something with it, I’d love to hear about it. Drop a message in the Discord server.

item.title: Embedding
item.author: support@warreport.app (Colin Schmale)
item.description:
War Report can display any single page on its own, with the app navigation stripped away, so you can embed it on your own website. This is useful for clan sites, blogs, or fan pages that want to show live data without sending visitors elsewhere.

How it works

Take the normal web address of the page you want to show and add ?embed=1 to the end, then load that URL inside an <iframe>.

In embed mode the bottom navigation, navigation rail, and back button are hidden, so the embedded view stays put and visitors always see exactly the page you embedded. Tapping a link that would normally open another page (a clan, a player, a war, and so on) instead opens that page in the full War Report app in a new browser tab, so the embed itself never navigates away. A small link back to War Report is shown in the corner.

Example: embed a player page

Every player has a page at https://warreport.app/players/<TAG>, where <TAG> is the player tag without the leading #. For example, the player with the tag #8UYVP00PV lives at https://warreport.app/players/8UYVP00PV.

To embed that player page, add ?embed=1 and drop the URL into an iframe:

<iframe
 src="https://warreport.app/players/8UYVP00PV?embed=1"
 width="400"
 height="700"
 style="border: none;"
 title="War Report player profile">
</iframe>

Adjust the width and height to fit your layout. The same approach also works for other pages such as clans, wars, and rankings. Just append ?embed=1 to the URL.
